description: Nucor is the largest steel manufacturer and recycler in North America. The company, founded in 1905, produces a variety of steel sheet products, bar products, and more through its steel mills segment, which serves steel service centers, fabricators, and manufacturers across North America. Nucor also operates through its steel products and raw materials segments. In addition to production, the company is involved in the steel trading, rebar distribution, and piling distribution businesses.

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Manufacturing and Production
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"This is a genuinely collaborative environment to its core. Teammates competing for promotions collaborate with each other and even conduct mock interviews for each other. Everyone understands that we all benefit from building our team up rather than focusing on our own personal gain. Teammates also have genuine care and compassion for each other. Even when TMs disagree on a matter, they still remain not just civil, but friendly, and when it comes to a work process, a collaborative approach is taken to ensure the best results."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Manufacturing and Production
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say: 

"Working at Nucor, you hear on day one, 'we are a family.' Often that seems like lip service at other facilities or entities, but at Nucor, I was able to experience this firsthand. I lost a cherished loved one and my plant manager didn't care about days missed, work not being completed, or productivity; he cared about my kids and how they would be impacted. He wanted to know if we had food at the house or a cleaning service while we were grieving. He wanted to ensure for the holidays we were together and that they enjoyed their holiday break. He cared about ME. That spoke volumes to the level of care this company—this family displayed for my family at home."

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: North Carolina–based steel manufacturer Nucor, whose extensive reuse of scrap metal makes it America’s biggest recycler, had an unprecedented 2021 as pent-up manufacturing activity from the first year of the pandemic increased demand for its products. The company, which maintains operations in the U.S., Mexico, and Canada, moved up 51 spots on this year’s list, with revenue increasing 81% year over year to $36.5 billion. That gain was partly due to an increased sales price per ton of steel—up 64% from 2020. But Nucor also shipped more product to customers: 28 million tons of steel, an 11% increase from 2020.
